wiki.title: Terry Falk
wiki.extract: Terry Falk is an American politician in the Montana House of Representatives. He was elected in 2024 to the 10th district, representing the west Kalispell area. Republican Falk defeated the Democratic candidate Devin T. Marconi with 75% of the vote. He was assigned as Chair for the Joint Appropriations Section A - General Government committee for the 2025 session.
